# تَدَارَأْتَ (tadāraʔta) /ta.daː.raʔ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَدَارَأَ (tadāraʔa)
# تَدَارَأْتِ (tadāraʔti) /ta.daː.raʔ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَدَارَأَ (tadāraʔa)
# تَدَارَأَتْ (tadāraʔat) /ta.daː.ra.ʔat/: third-person fem
